_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/eod-review/units.json and edit. Each key is a unit name usable as --unit <name> (shared by eod-review and eow-review). Explicit CLI flags override these. path supports ~ and, if it is a container folder, fans out to every child git repo (new repos are picked up automatically). all_branches:true logs every branch and drops the transcript branch filter. Omit a field to fall back to defaults (path=current dir, branch=current, author=git user.email).
_config_note: Repo roots, groups and personal projects go in ~/.claude/eod-review/config.json, e.g. {"dev_roots": ["~/code"], "groups": {"consulting": ["acme-site"], "side": ["my-blog"]}, "personal": ["my-journal"]}. Each group is reported separately; personal projects are kept out of the totals, except when targeted directly.
